intro.text: An Azish official, one of the applicants to become Prime Aqasix.

items.text: With the Assassin in White having killed the last two Primes in under a week, nobody wanted the post. When Lift slipped into the Bronze Palace with Huqin's crew, she overheard the viziers discussing applicants, and learned that Pandri had written an insult across the top of her application to get herself disqualified.
